title: Edge record
description: The caller's lineage claim, one per prompt(), published before the prompt is sent; on TRACE.{account}.edges, signed with Agent-Sender.

version.description: schema version of this record kind; additive changes bump it, breaking changes are a new subject

record_id.description: the Agent-Sender nonce for this signed record; also the Nats-Msg-Id

agent.description: the writer — the caller, the parent side of the edge

thread_id.description: the new thread, minted by the writer

parent_id.description: the writer's own thread; null for a root — the advertisement of a new tree

root_id.description: 128-bit random, lower-case hex, minted by the caller at prompt()

tool_call_id.description: the tool call that spawned the thread; null on a root

turn_count_hint.description: the writer's model-call count at spawn time; 0 on a root or before the first call; always written by the SDKs, 0 included; a hint, never a claim
